source: 63 stations (48 METAR, 15 DWD), 12 models of the Open-Meteo Previous Runs API, 2026-07-01..2026-10-12; one station row omitted from this export, the region and global rankings were computed with all 64

variables.t2m_c: temperature 2 m, MAE in deg C (hourly)
variables.wind10_ms: wind speed 10 m, MAE in m/s (hourly)
variables.precip_day: precipitation yes/no per UTC day (model >= 0.5 mm), error rate
